title: Employment Services Act 4 of 2014
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Employment Services Act 4 of 2014'. Commencement: 9 August 2015 (GG 39079). Its objects include facilitating 'the employment of foreign nationals'.
notes: Sections 8 and 9 regulate the employment of foreign nationals by employers. gov.za lists a 2026 Employment Services Amendment Bill that has not been enacted.
